title: Execute simple tasks directly
userStory: As a developer, I want simple tasks to execute without sub-stories so that small work isn't over-engineered.
acceptanceCriteria: Simple tasks (taskType: simple) have no childIds, execute as single unit
Simple task cards show 'Execute' button directly in Ready state
Execution uses task's prompt/instructions directly (no story breakdown)
Simple task history shows: triage result, execution log, PR link
